_about: Every natural thing of the game and what it is made of: its code, the share of each primordial (firmo is terra, aqua água, aura ar, igni fogo). There is no recipe to match: any mixture is matter, and one near a thing's code (within 5 points of each share) shows as that thing (docs/plano-materia-emergente.md). The four primordials are known; every other code is found by trying. Everything is particles, and one UMU is 256 of them (docs/particulas-design.md): a block of anything holds 4096 (16 UMU) in any state, and an item 256 (1 UMU) unless it says its own 'particles', as the items the game joins into a block do. A gas or a plasma with no forms shows as the nearest state that has some; a solid or a liquid with none is formless matter. 'beings' are the kinds of creature, each with the share of its body in each primordial and the creature that shows it: matter held by an anchor of vis is the being whose proportion is nearest.
_generated: Written by tools/materials_table.py: change the rules there, not here. Each recipe is the substance's code, its particles in a block as loose as earth (4096). The game packs each substance by its block's hardness over earth's (stone 3: 12288 in a block) and multiplies every form's particles by that (docs/particulas-design.md, Densidade).
